## About
Park Place Motorcars Fort Worth Service Center looks after Mercedes-Benz cars and vans from our spot on Bryant Irvin Road in Fort Worth. We handle everyday maintenance like oil service, tire rotations and filters, along with the factory A and B services your car calls for.
Our customers give us a 4.6 rating on Google from 753 reviews. Many of them mention their service representative by name and how well they were kept in the loop while their car was with us.

## Services
- Express Service: Quick routine maintenance with no appointment needed. We aim to get you in, out and on your way in about an hour or less, though actual time can vary.
- A service: Synthetic motor oil and oil filter replacement, fluid level checks, tire inflation check, brake component inspection and a maintenance counter reset, completed within 1 hour.
- B service: Everything in the oil and inspection routine plus a cabin dust/combination filter replacement, fluid checks, tire inflation check and brake component inspection.
- Routine maintenance: Headlight bulb replacement, tire rotation, wiper blades, air and cabin filters, and a multi-point inspection.
- Sprinter service: Service appointments for Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for Express Service?
A: No. You can come in for Express Service without scheduling, and most visits take about an hour or less.

Q: Which cars can get Service A or Service B?
A: Service A and Service B are for model years 2009 and newer.

Q: Can I get a loaner car while mine is in the shop?
A: A complimentary loaner is available for select services when extensive diagnostics and labor are required. Ask our service team for details.
